description: Non-Force cards shuffled into the 24-card War deck. Holdings stay attached to a Front; Tactics resolve when played and are discarded.

holding.play: Play beside one open Front; at most one of your Holdings in each Front.
holding.duration: Stays in play until another card discards it.

tactic.play: Resolve its printed effect immediately during deployment.

cards.title: Supply Camp
cards.effect: Forces played into this Front cost 1 less Command (minimum 0).

cards.title: Signal Tower
cards.effect: Your Archers in this Front may Attack Rear.

cards.title: Shieldworks
cards.effect: Enemy Attacks against your Forces here have -1 Force.

cards.title: War Banner
cards.effect: Your attacking Forces in this Front gain +1 Force.

cards.title: Forward Outpost
cards.effect: Move actions from this Front cost 0 Command.

cards.title: Field Hospital
cards.effect: When you play a Healer here, recover 1 Command.

cards.title: Forced March
cards.effect: Move one of your Forces to any empty permitted position in an open Front.

cards.title: Reinforcements
cards.effect: Play a Force from your hand for 2 less Command (minimum 0).

cards.title: Reconnaissance
cards.effect: Look at your top 3 War cards. Keep one; put the others on the bottom.

cards.title: Sabotage
cards.effect: Discard one enemy Holding in an open Front.

cards.title: Feint
cards.effect: Swap two of your Forces in the same Front.
